chapter_note: Extremely high substrate purity (0.935). The chapter is a sustained cosmological exposition of how the sea was formed — Living Spirit setting in order, King of Glory casting the three wheels, the dragon/Error cast down from the wheel of stars and mingled with sea, the sphere as winnowing-mechanism, the iron fastening peg, the watchers, and the three works of the prow. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system (winds, waters, fire, wheels, zodiacs, firmaments, sphere, watchers). Only the formulaic opening (i=3) is dialogue frame; the rest is unbroken substrate teaching, heavily damaged in the second half. No editorial seams flagged. The "iron fastening peg" and the painter/architect/coiner technical similes are preserved within the cosmic system (they describe how the sea functions as cosmic apparatus, not how it relates to the editor's institution).
